versions.changelog:
Initial version with major functional overhaul focused on PM job interview coaching:

- Replaced previous tech lead development workflow with a structured product manager (PM) interview coaching assistant.
- Added step-by-step process including company research, JD analysis, resume-JD matching, tailored mock interview, and targeted feedback.
- Emphasized real-world research, custom high-frequency interview questions, STAR-driven feedback, and resume improvement suggestions.
- Updated all content, output style, and workflow to suit Chinese-speaking PM candidates seeking interview preparation.
- Enforced new constraints: fact-based analysis, structured responses, and process-driven user guidance.
